summary: Revised Comprehensive Palm Store / Dlightek (Docs 57 & 84) Compliance & Hardening Plan incorporating all 10 security, privacy, and architectural audit criteria: Dashcam UI/manifest consistency (Rules 2.6 & 2.3), zero dynamic CDN code downloads for OCR (Rule 1.8), opt-in consent for crash diagnostics (Rule 1.5), APK asset decontamination, legacy Transsion WebView compatibility guards, elimination of third-party QR data leaks, full location transparency in Privacy Policy, removal of unused CameraX native libs, removal of jsDelivr font fallbacks, and placeholder API cleansing.
